description:
T1 - Oak TPO 1380089
Crown thinning up to 10% including deadwood, branches over gardens of 41 Elmfield Avenue and 20 Teddington Park by up to 1.5 metres.

The work is part of normal maintenance for a 200 year old tree and will give more light to the garden of 41 Elmfield Avenue  and clearance to the properties at 41 Elmfield Avenue and in the garden of 20 Teddington Park.

The height and the width of the oak will be the same before and after the works - approximately 17 metres high by 10 metres width.

Although the tree is sited in and owned by 20 Teddington Park, a large proportion of the oak tree overhangs the garden of 41 Elmfield Avenue and blocks light, continually denying plants in the garden of 41 Elmfield Avenue of water and light (to the point where we have laid artificial turf in the garden as the grass kept dying).

A substantial amount of deadwood falls into the garden of 41 Elmfield Avenue throughout the year.

Recently a property was built in the garden of 20 Teddington Park directly under the tree so the the owners of the tree at 20 Teddington Park are keen to properly maintain the tree so it does not cause damage to the building.

TPO consent was granted in 2017 and 2022 for the same works as being applied for here. This is continuing maintenance work.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
